items.summary: Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence is still missing. Progress is limited to official API, terms, and support review; partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft site terms. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is blocked pending written rights or an API agreement plus field-level limits for storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, prices, affiliate use, and advertising; smallest next action is to complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed pending data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior; smallest next action is a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed, conditionally supportable for consent-gated measurement only, pending deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, and jurisdictional review; smallest next action is a read-only consent/configuration capture without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed for operational use only, pending log fields, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident handling, subpoena handling, and data-subject-request procedures; smallest next action is a read-only log/vendor/incident/request inventory. No secondary sharing or monetization is cleared.

Fleet compliance and data-quality disposition: ordinary reversible growth is conditional, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, provided it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, cookie/analytics disclosure, affiliate disclosure, provenance and rights, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. The compliance scan is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors exist; revenue is partial aggregate, with $4.92 not assignable to a site. Do not treat unavailable telemetry as zero or claim legal certification.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or new queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence.
